reviews.text:
We took our cat here for 18 years. It was easy for them to take our money for 18 years when he was healthy. When he developed kidney issues we put him on special kidney food they prescribed. It didn’t work. I get it, he’s 18 years old. But we called 3x in one day to try and talk to a vet. We were told we’d get a call by EOD. We wanted to ask if there was a liquid or powder medicine available for his kidneys. If not, we were going to make the difficult decision because he was in obvious pain. We received no call by 6pm so I called back. The vet tech said “She (the vet) decided to dip out early today”.
She said she would have the vet from the Wheeling office call. No call.
My wife called back first thing the next morning. The importance of the situation was obvious as her voice was cracking in sadness as she fought back tears. Vet tech said there’s no guarantee the vet will call because the only available time is between appointments. No concern or care.
I will actively tell any friend or acquaintance to avoid this veterinarian.
They ghost you when you need them the most.

Higgins, do not try to contact us or post some bullsh!t reply. You failed. But thankfully you took tens of thousands of dollars from us before we really needed you.

This vet is unfortunately one of the worst ones that I have been to. Higgins Animal Clinic gives a very for-profit, upselling and overcharging energy that undermines any of the good medical work that I'm sure some of the clinical team attempts to provide.

They send spammy, marketing texts and emails (e.g., Summer 15% off medical tests! $25 anal gland expressions, etc). Everytime I go I am shocked by the bill, as they charge significantly more than any other vet I have been to. Whenever I have a basic medial question about my pet, they always respond with "We cannot answer, please schedule a visit and further testing", again creating a sense that they dont and will not serve their customers at all unless a hefty bill is attached.

A private equity firm or large financer must have bought this clinic to squeeze cash out, sad to see such a clinic operate. Would not recommend to anyone with a pet.
Always take good care of our pup!

We take our hedgehog here and he gets amazing care from Dr. Roberts. He’s extremely thorough and knowledgeable about hedgehogs and is also very kind and gentle with ours. We have taken our hedgehog to another exotic vet and I just don’t think he receives the same level of care there. The staff is also very kind. We would definitely recommend taking your hedgehog here.

I can't say enough great things about Higgins! The entire staff is wonderful, especially Dr. Damiana, Bree, Arielle, and Dr. Roberts. I've moved neighborhoods a few times and continue to come here. They always take the time to talk to you about any questions or concerns you have, are prompt about responding, and are so kind to my dogs. I'm so grateful for the care they get here!

I am so grateful for the care my cat, Nougat, receives at Higgins Animal Clinic!  She primarily visits Dr. Damiana and Melissa who truly go above and beyond - every visit feels calm, thoughtful, and unhurried.  The care my cat receives at Higgins is with genuine compassion.  Any treatments are always explained in clear, reassuring terms, and the team ensures I feel confident in any decisions at play.
What really stands out to me at Higgins is their follow-through: I receive frequent, caring check-ins after appointments, and this shows how much they truly care about their patients and the families who love their pets.  The front desk is welcoming, scheduling is very easy, and the clinic is spotless.
Thank you to Dr. Damiana, Melissa, and the entire team at Higgins!  I could not recommend them more.

I was dropping my dog off for surgery and observed a major lack of professionalism: a woman was yelling at one of the employees (perhaps she was the practice manager?). She berated them and was swearing at them. It was appalling. If this is how employees are treated without regard for customers, I can only imagine how the animals are treated behind closed doors. I will not be returning to this establishment.
overpriced, rude staff that never has time to do properly what they charge for. no proper care or compassion for the pets.

There was one time that Higgins upset me but it was more my reaction than them.  Other than that, they were perfect.  I have lived in 8 states, even more cities, and taken my dogs to many, many vets and let me tell you, I miss Higgins more than you can imagine.  If they were in Las Vegas, I would go to them for everything.

Yesterday I had to put down my beloved Pyrenees of 6 years. I got 2 of those extra years with her because of Dr. Damiana's poise and grace in always having an answer to keeping Annie's quality of life suitable and managing her pain. Though I moved recently, she even took the time to speak to me on the phone about the upcoming euthanasia. All of the techs and receptionists were always exceptionally kind with us and gentle with my girl. I would recommend them to anyone.

I highly advise to stay away from this clinic. They don’t take your concerns seriously and will chalk it up just as something regular. Went into clinic for vaccine shots today, and told them my dog seems to have a cough and I want to have him examined and see if antibiotics may help.

They went on to tell me I would have to come back another day… not because they were busy, but literally because they didn’t want to. The reason I say they aren’t busy is because when I paid the bill, not one person was doing a lick of work.  Stay away from these people, they care about your money and not your animals.

I absolutely love this place! The vets are super nice and informative. They're more than willing to answer any questions you have. I had to take my kitten in for stomach issues/potential blockage and they took me to the back, showed me his X-ray, and explained everything we were looking at which was very relieving. The receptionists have also been extremely helpful whenever we have called with questions. It is a bit on the expensive side, but without much to compare it to, I am happy paying their prices for the care my pets are getting there!
I absolutely love Higgins Animal Clinic! They will take of your fur friend. The staff are amazing and the doctors are fantastic! I highly recommend this clinic!

The care here was decent, but the costs were noticeably higher than other clinics, and I felt pressured with add-on products and services for my dog. I also didn’t like not being allowed in the room during exams. I’ve since switched to another veterinarian where prices are more reasonable, customer service is excellent, and I can stay with my dog throughout the visit. That will be my go-to moving forward.
I've been taking my cat to Higgins for several years and always receive wonderful care and service! Dr. Damiana is a great veterinarian and I'd absolutely recommend to anyone looking for a vet.

Dr. Damiana is one of the most thorough veterinarians around! She’s not only excellent with both my dog and cat, but also takes the time to explain diagnoses and answer any questions in detail. What I really appreciate is how she listens to our feedback and genuinely considers our concerns about our pets. You can tell she truly cares. I highly recommend Dr. Damiana at Higgins Animal Clinic!

Truly think this practice is in it for the money and not the wellbeing and care of animals. The veterinarians themselves are kind and knowledgeable. However, the way the practice is run leaves a lot to be desired.

The front desk staff consistently act like you’re inconveniencing them just by calling. They’re dismissive, unhelpful, and rarely return calls in a timely manner. Even for minor concerns, you’re often brushed off and told to head to an emergency vet—an expensive and unnecessary step most of the time.

Pricing here is also above average, and you get very little in the way of communication or follow-through to justify it.

Save yourself the frustration and go to BLVD Vet instead. The care, compassion, and professionalism there are night and day compared to this place.
We have two pet rabbits and take them to see Dr. Robert’s for check ups and receive great service and affordable care!
I've been taking my pets to Higgins since 1998 well worth the cost for the quality of care.

DO NOT GO TO THIS VET- NOT SAFE FOR PET

We took our dog, they took her back without us meeting the vet which was red flag number one.

We agreed on 3 vaccines for her, we were charged for 2.  I called them when we got home and asked if she had gotten the 3 vaccines or not and they said yes and I need to pay for the third one.  I have no proof that she was given the 3rd vaccine, so was not comfortable paying for it.  When I explained that I have no way of knowing that our dog received all 3 vaccines because the shots were not given in front of me and my receipt only reflects 2 shots, the receptionists laughed at me.

I have a call scheduled with the manager next week, I will change my review depending on how that goes, but most importantly I am not ok with them taking my pet without me having met the vet; that is unsafe.

Stanley is my 7 pound Yorkie and we rescued eachother about 5 years ago. I was told by his foster that he had been mistreated and had been known to bite. As we got to know eachother, it became crystal clear, based on his triggers, that someone had hit him in the face with an object. He is now a good and happy boy, loving and bossy and full of personality. He does, however, have a great deal of anxiety surrounding the vet and the groomer. Dr. Damiana and Ariel finesse him with humor, compassion, and patience. Now the bad news. Melissa is one of their senior techs and she is impatient, rude, humorless, and totally lacking in compassion. The same can be said for all of the male techs and groomers that we have encountered. Melissa has told me that she is afraid that my dog will bite. While I understand that, her fear and disdain make him even more anxious. I am a chef and there is always a risk that I could sustain a bad cut or a burn but if I am intimidated and fearful of those inevitabilities then perhaps I should choose another professesion right?  I cannot overstate the anger and anxiety that her behavior causes me and my dog. I will be sad to lose Dr. Damiana and Ariel but i just can't deal with or support this deplorable attitude and behavior by Melissa and the male techs. Our appointment today was for a quick sanitary butt shave and nail trim and it was a wall to wall nightmare. A friend of mine who is deep into the animal rescue community once accompanied me to pick Stanley up. With a passing glance she said that the aforementioned behavior was both unprofessional and unacceptable. Don’t give them your time or your money. There have to be better vet practices and I'm now going to find one.
Great doctors and support staff. I've taken my cats here for years and everyone is always wonderful!

I have been taking my pups to Higgins for years! The level of service and advice I get from the vet and the employees are very helpful. The young lady Arielle is always giving me suggestions and calling to make sure my fur babies are okay. This is a great place for your four legged family members

The worst veterinary clinic .   Do not take your pet.

I took my cat for his annual visit.  I sat in the waiting room for over an hour and was told they would be right with me.  I come to learn they examined my cat without inviting me into the room .   There was a special for a free nail trim.  I requested his nails be cut three times.  They failed to do so.  They did not send me an invoice or give a rabies tag but charged me for a rabies shot.  They charged me for a fecal test but never gave me the results and charged me $210.

LOVE Higgins and Dr Damiana! The MOST compassionate care personalized for our babies: 1 kitty & 2 dogs: Dr and staff genuinely give their all to know and understand each pets’ needs and provide the BEST care!

I've been taking my cat in to Higgins ever since I adopted him over 5 years ago. He's had a few health issues throughout the years and while stressful to deal with, I am at ease knowing the staff takes great care of him. I moved farther away but still go here knowing he's in good hands.
My vet clinic since 1967. Need I say more?

Today I brought in my pup Gael, my pup is a special case to say the least. The Doctor and the vet tech insured Gael was up to date with his vaccines and did a very through check up. My pup sufers from past traumas and can be aggressive, they did a wonderful job handling him and did everything gently. He was there for a groom. I am a dog groomer myself and I was not able to groom him. The groomer there i belive his name was Enrique was very kind and did an excellent job, Gael did have matting  yet not one knick or clipper burn.  Everyone was very kind and really looked like they care for my pets well being. I'm more than pleased and happy to be a new client!

I have taken my dog to Higgins for a few years, my gf from Roscoe Village had referred me to Higgins Vet.
Everyone there was so attentive and nice, the receptionists were always so cordial and always called me back promptly.
During Covid the operations changed and it was absolutely fine, we parked in the back at their designated lot and called in and someone came to see and pick up our dog to take it to a consultation while we waited.
Thank you for being the best vets in town!

I stopped in yesterday to because my cat passed away and was seeking cremation services. I called ahead and they said yes you can come in but any veterinary office should be able to help you. Ok I said I am not a patient but was at some …
Great experience! Joshua was amazing, kind and helpful! Veterinarian very personable and knowledgeable with great bedside manner. A++

We would take our beloved lil dog (boy) to Higgins animal clinic for almost a decade. His annual check-up is every year on the first week of December, so he did, 12-2-2023. We've noticed that around the fall of 2023 he had developed some …
Dr. D helped me on the hardest day of letting my buddy go.

Higgins AC has been taking care of our Chihuahua for over 6 years since we adopted. The latest was a painful shoulder issue that they made time for him immediately. The doctors are always caring and detailed. Their explanations are easy to understand, and they follow up. Definitely recommended.
